title: Supervised executor result (schema 1)
description: Written by scripts/executor-orchestrator.mjs after a Codex worker child settles, and by every refusal that never reached a spawn. `status` says what happened to the run; `execution` says whether a second model ever handled the input; `delta` / `out_of_scope` / `baseline` say what the run did to the working tree, derived from a pair of snapshots taken around the child and never from a final `git status` alone. Exit 0 means status completed AND baseline ok AND out_of_scope empty; anything else exits 3.

author_host.description: The host that ASKED for the run. A Codex author is recorded and refused, never rewritten — no site may count a second Codex process as an independent opinion.

summary_line.description: One line the calling skill prints verbatim: Executor: NOT EXECUTED | EXECUTED, REJECTED | EXECUTED, BASELINE DEVIATION | EXECUTED, OUT OF SCOPE | EXECUTED, COMPLETED.

output_json.description: The final message parsed and validated against the caller's --schema. Always present: null whenever no schema was given or nothing validated. This schema types the field; the caller's schema types its content.

delta.description: Paths whose working-tree state changed DURING this run. Pre-existing dirt the child never touched is absent; a further edit to an already-dirty path is present.

technical_retry.description: This run consumed the lineage's single technical retry.

technical_retry_allowed.description: A failure that left no delta, no baseline deviation, no timeout and no spent budget may be retried once with --technical-retry yes.
